title: P3 Capsule
description: Privacy-preserving encrypted provenance vault for UACI-bound AI-generated content

uaci_id.description: Globally unique UACI identifier for this content asset

model_name.description: Name and version of the AI model that generated the content

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of content generation in ISO-8601 format

user_hash.description: Salted SHA-256 hash of user identifier — original value never stored. Salt rotated every 30 days.

intent_hash.description: Salted SHA-256 hash of generation intent or prompt — original value never stored. Salt rotated every 30 days.

hmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the concatenated canonical fields — provides integrity verification without key exposure

upif_handshake.description: Optional UPIF integration — records prompt governance chain for full-stack provenance

upif_id.description: UPIF prompt identifier from the PAIR Router handshake

notes.encryption: The P3 Capsule is encrypted at rest using AES-GCM with a 96-bit nonce. Keys are managed via KMS with 90-day rotation.
notes.gdpr_erasure: Key destruction permanently prevents decryption — satisfying GDPR Art 17 right to erasure.
notes.legal_hold: Key escrow enables lawful decryption under subpoena without exposing the general KMS.
notes.status: Schema v1.0.0 — specification stage. Implementation pending.
